sections.Profile:
Flying Turns, released by Midway Manufacturing Co. in July 1964, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine themed around auto racing.

- Manufacturer: Midway Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1964
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Backbox Gimmick, Racing, Sports, Original Theme
